content: {"sameness":"Every page is the same skeleton: slim top bar with wordmark left and 2–4 tiny nav links right, then one big display headline (3 lines), one short paragraph, address line, one small pill 'Pokličite' button. Three repeated hero compositions: text-left/photo-right (optika, sirarna, steklarstvo, pivovarna), full-width photo over a dark band with headline (kolesarski, vinarstvo), or no photo at all (atelje, plesna, urarstvo). Type rotates between a condensed grotesk caps and a heavy serif; the paragraph font is identical everywhere. Photos are all warm, shallow-focus, product-close-up stock crops. Mobile: same stacked order, same sticky Klic/Navodila bar and 'AI-generated images' disclaimer strip.","recurringIssues":["Mobile sticky action bar overlaps content on several pages (kolesarski, sirarna, steklarstvo), with the AI-image disclaimer strip colliding with text.","Three pages (atelje, plesna, urarstvo) have no imagery at all, leaving large empty white first screens.","Headline/paragraph/button is the only hierarchy; no page has a distinctive second element beyond one photo.","Photo-right heroes crop images awkwardly (optika, steklarstvo) and float them without relation to the text block.","Call-to-action buttons are small and visually weak relative to the oversized headlines.","Phone layouts truncate or cut the headline/paragraph (plesna, steklarstvo) and show mobile views that don't resemble the desktop hero."],"overall":3,"variety":2,"best":[{"id":"sirarna-pr-simnu","why":"Strong photo, confident serif headline overlapping the image, warm palette tied to the product; works on both desktop and phone."},{"id":"pivovarna-rov","why":"Bold ochre field and heavy serif give it a real brand feel, though the cut-off photo on desktop is weak."},{"id":"pasji-salon-kodra","why":"Terracotta header and tight headline feel purposeful; the only page with a clearly owned colour."}],"weakest":[{"id":"plesna-sola-takt","why":"A contact table in the hero, no image, no energy; nothing says dance school."},{"id":"atelje-bergant","why":"Desktop first screen is mostly empty white, headline isolated, no visual of any architecture."},{"id":"steklarstvo-vrhovnik","why":"Headline collides with the photo, mobile crop and overlapping sticky bar break the screen."}],"oneChange":"Break the single hero template: give each business its own first-screen composition and a real second visual element (gallery, product list, map, pricing teaser), so the page shows what the business does rather than one headline plus one stock-style photo.","summary":"This is a competent template shop, not yet a studio. The pages are clean, readable and consistently built, but all ten share one skeleton: wordmark bar, big three-line headline, short paragraph, small call button, optional photo. Colour and font swaps don't hide it. Three pages have no image at all and feel unfinished; others crop or float photos without care. On phones the sticky call bar and disclaimer strip overlap content on several sites. Sirarna, Pivovarna and Pasji salon show the direction to take: a strong owned colour, a confident headline and a photo that is part of the composition. Push every page to that level and vary the hero structure per trade."}
